interaction_history.overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.
interaction_history.title: Matrix, The

interaction_history.overview: In this biographical film, glamorous yet lonely star Joan Crawford takes in two orphans, and at first their unconventional family seems happy. But after Joan's attempts at romantic fulfillment go sour and she is fired from her contract with MGM studios, her callous and abusive behavior towards her daughter Christina becomes even more pronounced. Christina leaves home and takes her first acting role, only to find her mother's presence still overshadowing her.
interaction_history.title: Mommie Dearest

interaction_history.overview: Hassled by the school bullies, Daniel LaRusso has his share of adolescent woes. Luckily, his apartment building houses a resident martial arts master: Kesuke Miyagi, who agrees to train Daniel ... and ends up teaching him much more than self-defense. Armed with newfound confidence, skill and wisdom, Daniel ultimately faces off against his tormentors in this hugely popular classic underdog tale.
interaction_history.title: Karate Kid, The

interaction_history.overview: Black comedy about a young man who creates a carnivorous plant and must kill in order to feed it.
interaction_history.title: Little Shop of Horrors, The

interaction_history.overview: Set in 1929, a political boss and his advisor have a parting of the ways when they both fall for the same woman.
interaction_history.title: Miller's Crossing

interaction_history.overview: A collection of twentysomethings try to cope with relationships, loneliness, desire and their individual neuroses.
interaction_history.title: 200 Cigarettes

interaction_history.overview: An Australian couple take a sailing trip in the Pacific to forget about a terrible accident. While on the open sea, in dead calm, they come across a ship with one survivor who is not at all what he seems.
interaction_history.title: Dead Calm

interaction_history.overview: A group of young gunmen, led by Billy the Kid, become deputies to avenge the murder of the rancher who became their benefactor. But when Billy takes their authority too far, they become the hunted.
interaction_history.title: Young Guns

interaction_history.overview: In this modern take on Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol," Frank Cross (Bill Murray) is a wildly successful television executive whose cold ambition and curmudgeonly nature has driven away the love of his life, Claire Phillips (Karen Allen). But after firing a staff member, Eliot Loudermilk (Bobcat Goldthwait), on Christmas Eve, Frank is visited by a series of ghosts who give him a chance to re-evaluate his actions and right the wrongs of his past.
interaction_history.title: Scrooged

interaction_history.overview: This film chronicles the life of Lane Frost, 1987 PRCA Bull Riding World Champion, his marriage and his friendships with Tuff Hedeman (three-time World Champion) and Cody Lambert.
interaction_history.title: 8 Seconds
